name: daviddtech-charts
description: DaviddTech+ charts in Claude Code: the last forecast (fan, level odds, plan odds, scan ranges) drawn in a pane beside the chat, with a short line above the prompt and /daviddtech-chart.

autoOpen.title: Open the chart pane
autoOpen.description: sidebar opens the pane by itself only where it can sit beside the chat (desktop app, wide fullscreen terminal); always tries every time; never waits for /daviddtech-chart.

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: on shows a one-line summary with a Chart button after each new forecast; off never shows it.
